title: Social commerce edges past SEO at The Independent for the first time
description: The Independent’s social-commerce revenue edged past its SEO-based commerce revenue for the first time in September, CEO Christian Broughton said at Digiday’s Media Strategies event in London this week.

description:

description: Chipotle, Pringles, DoorDash, Sprite, Gymshark, and more are behind the week’s most notable ads.

title: Reach CEO touts Google AI deal as a template, steps up pressure on OpenAI over scraping
description: Digiday spoke with Reach CEO Piers North about his plans to make its Google AI content deal a blueprint framework for other LLM deals, and its recent cease-and-desist letter to OpenAI.

title: Ruggable’s new ad spend strategy shifts focus to ShopMy creators
description: Since last August, Ruggable has shifted about 10% of its overall spend from performance channels, like Meta, into brand channels, like influencers and connected television. The brand plans to grow that spend by another 15% to 20% next year, chief marketing and creative officer Lauren Sherman-Kaoud said.

title: Bealls to debut mobile app
description: The app is intended to create a more connected shopping experience across channels, while also supporting the retailer’s strategy around loyalty.

title: Lululemon restructures raw materials team, lays off 7 people
description: The changes came in August, a spokesperson told Retail Dive, just a few weeks before the arrival of new CEO Heidi O’Neill.

title: Wendy’s signs on as first sponsor for in-app Bravo fan experience
description: The hub features a personalized feed of content curated from popular franchises and an artificial intelligence-generated avatar of Andy Cohen.

title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
description: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.

title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
description: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

title: Stripe agentic commerce revs up
description: The digital payment juggernaut’s agentic commerce activity went “vertical” last month, President John Collison said this week.

title: Transactional email: What it is and how it works
description: Transactional emails are automated messages triggered by a specific action a customer takes, sent to help that person complete or follow up on something already in progress. An order receipt, a password reset confirmation, or a shipping notification are all examples of transactional emails because each one delivers information tied to an action the recipient just took.
